# Breadcrumb
Atlas Breadcrumb v1 — the path to the current page as a hierarchy of links. 2 separator styles (chevron, dot).

When to use: on pages nested two or more levels deep so people can move back up the hierarchy. When not to use: as primary navigation, or on top-level pages.

Accessibility: render as <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> with an ordered list; the last item is the current page (aria-current="page", not a link); separators are decorative (aria-hidden); the ellipsis is a button labelled "Show more"; a Dropdown item is a button with aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded whose menu the caller supplies. Links are plain anchors.
